stories.title: Prince William and Kate Middleton visit Mumbai
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales arrived in Mumbai for a three-day visit focused on the Earthshot Prize and British trade links. The couple met with prize finalists and participated in local engagements, including a cricket match and a ride on the Mumbai Metro.

stories.title: Royal couple continues Mumbai tour
stories.summary: Prince William and Kate Middleton spent Tuesday meeting Earthshot Prize finalists at Bandra Reclamation Garden. The visit included a ride in an electric autorickshaw, with the Prince behind the wheel. Fashion observers noted the couple's choice of an ivory pantsuit and a pinstriped blazer for the outing.

stories.title: Royals meet Earthshot Prize finalists in Mumbai
stories.summary: Prince William and Kate Middleton met with 15 finalists for the Earthshot Prize 2026 at Bandra Reclamation Garden. The visit included a ride in an electric rickshaw, which the couple used to navigate the city during their second day of engagements in India.

stories.title: Prince William wears Indian label in Mumbai
stories.summary: Prince William appeared in Mumbai wearing a navy-blue Nehru-style jacket from the Indian label KARDO. The garment, worn over a white shirt, was a last-minute addition to the Prince's wardrobe for his three-day visit to India alongside Kate Middleton.

stories.title: Royal couple brings blue to Mumbai
stories.summary: Kate Middleton and Prince William continued their India visit with appearances at Ballard Estate and the Mumbai Metro. The Princess wore a cobalt-blue dress, while the Prince opted for navy tailoring. The engagements highlighted sustainable urban development and included a cricket match with local schoolchildren.

stories.title: Kate Middleton rewears Roksanda dress in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Princess of Wales wore a cobalt-blue midi dress by London-based label Roksanda during a visit to Mumbai's Vidhan Bhavan Metro Station. The bespoke piece was previously worn by the Princess at Wimbledon in July 2025.

stories.title: The choice of wearing sarees
stories.summary: Some women choose to wear sarees on ordinary days without specific functions or dress codes. While often labeled as traditional, these choices are increasingly viewed as a personal statement by modern, working women who are comfortable with their identity and daily decisions.

stories.title: Streetwear gains traction in India
stories.summary: Streetwear in India has evolved from a niche interest into a significant cultural marker, with high demand for limited-edition drops. Luxury houses have begun to take notice, blurring the lines between traditional high-end fashion and youth-driven styles influenced by global skate and hip-hop culture.

stories.title: Ananya Panday discusses personal style
stories.summary: Actor Ananya Panday joined editor Rasna Bhasin at Harper’s Bazaar India LuXperiences to discuss her approach to personal style. The conversation covered the actor's fashion aspirations, the importance of meaningful brand associations, and her current list of preferred designers.

stories.title: Pune to host Mukta fashion show
stories.summary: The Mukta fashion show will take place on December 12 in Pune. The event aims to present the life stories of nine women through symbolic forms of nature, focusing on themes of resilience and freedom. The program includes the Majestique Maharashtra 2026 pageant.

stories.title: Libas launches wedding campaign
stories.summary: Libas has unveiled the third season of its Saj Dhaj Ke wedding campaign. The brand is expanding its focus beyond bridal wear to include the broader wardrobe and experiences surrounding Indian weddings, emphasizing the collective nature of wedding preparations and family festivities.

stories.title: Giriraj Singh to inaugurate ‘Handloom Haat: The Handloom Experience Centre’ at Delhi’s Janpath on August 14 - DD News
Brad Pitt and Ines de Ramon attend premiere
stories.summary: Brad Pitt and Ines de Ramon attended the Los Angeles premiere of The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth. De Ramon wore an ivory Roberto Cavalli dress featuring cutouts and a crocodile-effect finish, while Pitt opted for a navy sweater and a winter-ready jacket.

stories.title: Hunter Schafer and Michelle Yeoh attend London screening
stories.summary: Hunter Schafer and Michelle Yeoh attended a screening of Blade Runner 2099 in London. Schafer wore a monochrome Celine ensemble featuring a strapless minidress-silhouetted top and trousers, while Yeoh opted for a look by Givenchy by Sarah Burton.

stories.title: Elle honours women in Hollywood
stories.summary: The 2026 Elle Women in Hollywood celebration recognized eight individuals for their contributions to film, television, and music. The event featured a variety of eveningwear, with Ralph Lauren designs appearing prominently on the red carpet.

stories.title: Pamela Anderson on holiday season
stories.summary: Pamela Anderson is focusing on quieter holiday traditions, including gardening and cooking. The actor prefers gifts with personal significance, such as family photographs or heirloom jewelry, as part of her approach to the season.

stories.title: Royals attend Earthshot Awards
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales attended the Earthshot Awards ceremony in Mumbai. The couple chose clothing to pay tribute to their Indian hosts as they walked the green carpet at the environmental event.

stories.title: Royals wear Indian designers at Earthshot gala
stories.summary: Prince William and Kate Middleton wore Indian designers to the Earthshot Prize gala in Mumbai. Kate wore a red anarkali by Mahima Mahajan made from handwoven silk georgette, while William wore a black bandhgala by Manish Malhotra.

stories.title: Princess of Wales highlights sustainable fashion in India
stories.summary: The Princess of Wales is using her three-day visit to India, which coincides with the Earthshot Prize awards, to showcase sustainable fashion. The tour features a mix of wardrobe staples and innovative materials. The awards were founded in 2020 to recognise solutions to environmental challenges.

stories.title: A look back at royal tour wardrobes in India
stories.summary: During their 2016 tour of India, the royal couple coordinated their attire with local textile traditions. The wardrobe included an Alexander McQueen dress featuring paisley prints and a tunic by Mumbai-based designer Anita Dongre. The selections aimed to blend the fashion heritage of both nations.

stories.title: Royal and fictional aristocrats meet at Earthshot
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales attended the sixth Earthshot Prize summit alongside actor Simone Ashley, known for her role in the series Bridgerton. The two were photographed together while wearing coordinating outfits. The event brought together real-life royalty and small-screen aristocracy.

stories.title: Fiona Shaw joins BBC adaptation of A Passage to India
stories.summary: Fiona Shaw has been cast in a five-part BBC and CBC adaptation of E M Forster's novel A Passage to India. The drama is scripted and directed by Richie Mehta. Shaw joins a cast that includes Ali Fazal and Tom Mison for the production.

stories.title: Prada opens permanent exhibition in Milan
stories.summary: Prada has launched a permanent exhibition in Milan titled Pradasphere, featuring historical designs and a spacesuit prototype. The brand describes the exhibition as a multiplier for its heritage. Prada projects the installation will anchor the brand's expansion in the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.

stories.title: Tel Aviv designers experiment with bold silhouettes
stories.summary: Emerging designers at Tel Aviv Fashion Week are incorporating recycled fabrics and unexpected textures into their collections. The local design community continues to operate despite geographical isolation and regional conflicts. The current generation of designers is focusing on reinvention and bold silhouettes.

stories.title: Gold loan lenders anticipate repayment challenges
stories.summary: Gold loan companies expect a difficult third quarter as falling gold prices pressure borrowers with high loan-to-value ratios. Lenders are shifting their focus toward asset quality and collection efforts. Growth in the sector is expected to remain muted as prices decline.

stories.title: Gold and silver prices remain near one-year lows
stories.summary: Gold and silver prices continue to trade near their lowest levels in over a year despite a modest recovery on Tuesday. The correction offers some relief to buyers ahead of the Indian wedding season. Consumers are currently weighing whether to purchase now or wait for further price changes.

stories.title: Gold prices fall for fifth consecutive session
stories.summary: The price of 24-carat gold fell by 760 rupees to 1,36,040 rupees per 10 grams on Tuesday. This marks the fifth consecutive day of declines for the precious metal. Bullion rates do not include applicable taxes.

stories.title: Gold rates decline in Hyderabad
stories.summary: Gold prices in Hyderabad fell on November 17, with 18-carat gold priced at 1,02,030 rupees per 10 grams. Prices dropped by 570 rupees compared to the previous day. Buyers are advised to verify final costs with local jewellers, as prices vary by store.

stories.title: Chennai gold prices drop across categories
stories.summary: Gold prices in Chennai declined on Tuesday according to the Madras Jewellers and Diamond Traders Association. The 22-carat gold rate fell to 12,470 rupees per gram. Prices for 18-carat and 14-carat gold also decreased, while silver prices remained unchanged.

stories.title: Chennai gold price falls below one lakh rupees
stories.summary: Gold prices in Chennai dropped to 99,760 rupees per sovereign on Tuesday, falling below the one lakh rupee mark for the first time since December 2025. Prices have declined for five consecutive trading sessions. Gold reached an all-time high earlier this year.

stories.title: Gold prices dip in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Gold prices in Chennai and Coimbatore fell on Tuesday, with 22-carat gold dropping to 12,470 rupees per gram. The price of an 8-gram sovereign is now below one lakh rupees. Silver prices remained stable during the latest trading session.

stories.title: Gold prices vary in Delhi ahead of wedding season
stories.summary: Gold prices in Delhi saw 24-carat gold reach 1,34,700 rupees per 10 grams on Tuesday, a slight increase from the previous close. Demand for jewellery is expected to rise as the wedding season begins on November 20. Consumers are using current rates as a reference.

stories.title: Jewellers report decline in gold and silver rates
stories.summary: Leading jewellers including Tanishq and Malabar Gold reported lower rates for gold and silver on Tuesday. The India Bullion and Jewellers Association also noted a decline in indicative prices. Market analysts attribute the trend to a firmer US dollar.

stories.title: India gems and jewelry exports up 34.01% to nearly ₹27,862.82cr - NewsBytes
India reports surge in jewellery exports
stories.summary: Gross exports of gems and jewellery grew by 34.01 percent to 27,862.82 crore rupees in October 2026. The increase was driven by strong demand for studded gold and lab-grown diamonds. Imports also rose by 85.85 percent during the same period.

stories.title: Diwali timing impacts polished diamond exports
stories.summary: India's polished diamond exports rose 10.5 percent to 1.13 billion dollars in October. The increase is attributed to the timing of Diwali, which allowed factories to operate longer than in 2025. Exports had previously declined for three consecutive months.

stories.title: UGG releases holiday capsule
stories.summary: UGG has released a holiday collection featuring campaign stars like rapper JT and Megan Skiendiel. The brand says the campaign emphasizes what the holidays are all about, which it identifies as gift-giving and shoes. Santa reportedly stopped by the offices early to deliver the boxes.

stories.title: London Fog Watches partners with Arjun Kapoor
stories.summary: London Fog Watches has appointed actor Arjun Kapoor as the face of the brand and Co-Creative Director for Watches. The partnership aims to strengthen the brand's presence in India. Kapoor will work on product design and creative direction for the American heritage lifestyle brand.

stories.title: Titan Eye+ partners with Marvel for running event
stories.summary: Titan Eye+ has become the official eyewear partner for Marvel The Unrivaled Run. The collaboration aims to connect the worlds of eyewear, fandom, and fitness. Participants are invited to step into the world of their favorite superheroes through the immersive running experience.

stories.title: QUE Universe launches luxury eyewear collection
stories.summary: QUE Universe has introduced QUE Luxe, a collection of 10 styles described as bringing contemporary eyewear into occasion dressing. The company says the range complements traditional and contemporary outfits. The Indian sunglasses segment was valued at approximately USD 1.58 billion in 2024.

stories.title: This iconic shoe, exhibited at the Museum of Modern Art, is now available in India - Prestige Online - Singapore
Onitsuka Tiger adds fur to winter footwear
stories.summary: Onitsuka Tiger is introducing a Fur Series in India, applying faux fur to three of its signature footwear styles. The collection reinterprets familiar silhouettes with tactile textures. The brand says it is combining its distinctive aesthetic with a seasonal update for the approaching winter.

stories.title: Louis Vuitton unveils F1 trophy trunk
stories.summary: Louis Vuitton has unveiled a bespoke trophy trunk for the 2026 Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix. The handcrafted case features signature Monograms and a personalized Victory patch. The design honors the brand's 129-year heritage in automotive culture, while the race will feature Louis Vuitton trackside signage.

stories.title: Jaeger-LeCoultre turns watchmaking into an escape room
stories.summary: Jaeger-LeCoultre has collaborated with designer Zain Memon to create a physical escape room based on its watch complications. The brand's CMO Matthieu Le Voyer says he received feedback that he was crazy for wanting to develop a game. The project is now housed inside the company's manufacture.

stories.title: Robert Pattinson's Bond role creates watch speculation
stories.summary: Robert Pattinson's casting as the next James Bond has prompted speculation regarding the future of the 007 watch contract. Omega has held the partnership for 31 years, but Pattinson's existing ambassadorship with Jaeger-LeCoultre has led to public discussion about a potential change in the spy's wristwear.

stories.title: Brooks reissues 2004 Cascadia 1 trail runner
stories.summary: Brooks and Bare Knuckles have reissued the Cascadia 1, a trail shoe originally released in 2004. The limited-edition version features distressed suede and maintains the performance line of the original. It was notably worn by Scott Jurek during his sixth Western States 100 victory.

stories.title: Nonnative opens Hong Kong pop-up
stories.summary: Nonnative has arrived at Gallery HBX in Hong Kong for the Fall/Winter 2026 season. The launch includes a GORE-TEX archive exhibition and collaborative releases with brands including GUIDI and FRGMT. The event is titled Sky's The Limit.

stories.title: Travis Scott and Nike prepare GTA 6 footwear
stories.summary: Travis Scott, Rockstar Games, and Nike are reportedly collaborating on a collection of Air Force 1 Low sneakers. The pack is expected to feature two colorways and is rumored to launch on November 21. The collection is tied to the upcoming GTA 6 release.

stories.title: AGI Denim introduces fit-retention technology
stories.summary: AGI Denim has launched FitSteady, a stretch denim innovation intended to prevent size changes after laundering. The manufacturer says stretch denim often shrinks unpredictably, which can frustrate consumers and erode brand confidence. The technology aims to preserve the garment's authentic look and fit.

stories.title: India expands textile manufacturing capacity
stories.summary: Gujarat has approved textile project applications worth approximately $500 million. While the US is India's largest textile export market, accounting for 29 percent of exports in the last fiscal year, it remains unclear if the new facilities are specifically targeting that region for future orders.

stories.title: Emerging brands look to India for sourcing
stories.summary: Supply chain disruptions in Bangladesh are prompting emerging fashion brands to seek manufacturing alternatives. Sourcing firms are currently positioning India as a flexible option for smaller labels. Large retailers have the capacity to shift orders between countries, but smaller brands face more significant challenges.

stories.title: Bangladesh footwear exports increase
stories.summary: Bangladesh earned $457.01 million from footwear exports between July and October of the 2026-27 fiscal year. This figure represents a 9.37 percent increase compared to the same period in the previous year, when exports totaled $417.85 million.

stories.title: Handloom Expo offers discounts in Sambhajinagar
stories.summary: A Handloom Expo featuring textiles and handicrafts from 14 Indian states is currently being held at the Tapadia-Kasliwal Ground. The exhibition offers a 20 percent discount on products purchased directly from the weavers. The event includes more than 150 varieties of traditional goods.

India and Egypt discuss trade and cotton
stories.summary: India and Egypt have agreed to establish a joint working group to explore a preferential or free trade agreement. The countries identified textiles and cotton as key areas for cooperation. India currently imports and exports apparel with Egypt, while seeking high-quality cotton to supply its textile industry.

stories.title: AAFA sees recycling potential in CAFTA-DR
stories.summary: The American Apparel and Footwear Association identified opportunities for textile-to-textile recycling in the CAFTA-DR region. The study cites proximity to the US and existing manufacturing bases as advantages, recommending trade incentives and clearer customs procedures to address barriers and accelerate capacity for regional recycling efforts.

stories.title: Sri Lanka proposes budget measures for apparel
stories.summary: Sri Lanka’s Budget 2027 proposes investment incentives, VAT reforms, and trade facilitation to boost textile and apparel exports. While the industry has welcomed the measures, it is seeking lower investment thresholds and clearer rules. Implementation remains subject to parliamentary approval and coordination among various government agencies.

stories.title: Canada and China agree to expand trade
stories.summary: Canada and China have agreed to new trade measures following a meeting between Prime Minister Mark Carney and President Xi Jinping. The package includes tariff relief for Canadian exports and extended remissions for Chinese metals. The countries also scheduled a 2027 trade mission and a year of e-commerce.

stories.title: Canada and China deepen trade ties at APEC
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney and President Xi Jinping met at the APEC summit to discuss trade restrictions and market access. Carney described the meeting as a recalibration of the relationship. This follows a visit to Beijing earlier this year, the first by a Canadian head of state since 2017.

stories.title: The battle over fashion’s waste crisis - Financial Times
Sustainable holiday gift guide
stories.summary: Editors are curating gift ideas from brands rated through a proprietary system. The guide encourages consumers to find gifts within their budgets that also meet sustainability criteria. Purchases made through provided links may earn the publisher a commission to support their ongoing editorial work.

stories.title: ASICS ethics under review
stories.summary: ASICS claims it exists to uplift the world through sport, but its ethics are currently rated as a start by industry analysts. The rating was published in April 2026 and may not reflect recent corporate claims. Analysts continue to rerate thousands of brands within the directory.

stories.title: Ireland ranks first for fast fashion waste
stories.summary: Ireland generates the highest fast fashion waste score among 62 countries, according to a study by Arka. Textiles account for 6 percent of the nation's municipal waste, or 38kg per person annually. The country imports significantly more clothing per resident than it exports to international markets.

stories.title: Inditex backs decarbonization fund
stories.summary: Inditex has joined a new 250 million dollar blended-finance fund aimed at decarbonizing textile and footwear supply chains. Developed by the International Finance Corporation and managed by SIMA, the fund targets energy efficiency and pollution reduction projects in emerging markets. Inditex is an anchor investor.

stories.title: Agentic AI discussed for textile recyclers
stories.summary: The Secondary Materials and Recycled Textiles Association recently hosted a conference in Montreal focused on the circular economy. Keynote speaker Oliver Ardery demonstrated how agentic AI can provide workflow automation for industrial and manufacturing companies, specifically targeting back-office and front-office tasks for textile processors and exporters.

stories.title: Jiwya launches plant-based luxury collection
stories.summary: Luxury fashion brand Jiwya has launched its SS'27 collection, Aarsa. The brand describes the collection as a visual and emotional interrogation of society, using the mirror as a central metaphor. The launch marks the brand's third anniversary and features 25 pieces across dresses and skirts.

stories.title: Gen Z shifts toward pre-loved fashion
stories.summary: Thrift shopping is gaining popularity among Gen Z consumers who are choosing vintage clothing over branded outfits. The trend is driven by a preference for affordability, individuality, and sustainable fashion. Young shoppers are increasingly mixing classic vintage pieces with modern styling to create distinctive personal wardrobes.

stories.title: EU proposes Digital Fairness Act
stories.summary: The European Commission has proposed a Digital Fairness Act to align online consumer protection with offline rules. The proposal includes powers to investigate major cases and issue fines of up to 6 percent of worldwide annual turnover. The measures now await review by the Parliament and Council.

stories.title: Ethical fashion market sees expansion
stories.summary: The ethical fashion sector is reportedly gaining traction as consumer awareness regarding social and environmental impacts grows. Innovative business models and sustainability initiatives are driving industry expansion. Analysts are currently exploring the market status, key players, and trends that are expected to shape the industry's future growth.

stories.title: How to Rebuild Fashion E-Commerce for the AI Era - The Business of Fashion
Global Fashion Summit returns to Copenhagen
stories.summary: The Global Fashion Summit is returning to Copenhagen under the theme of business not as usual. The event aims to address how shifting consumer expectations, regulation, and climate crises are rewriting industry rules. Discussions will focus on the emerging fashion system through the lenses of policy and finance.

stories.title: Coalition sets 2027 carbon market priorities
stories.summary: The OCCCM adopted the COP31 Declaration at a ministerial meeting in Antalya to reaffirm cooperation on compliance carbon markets. The coalition, which includes 13 members and 34 observers, set its 2027 priorities. Brazil chaired the meeting, with China and the EU serving as co-chairs.

stories.title: Luxury Stocks Slip on Fears AI Falls Will Curb Spending by Wealthy - The Business of Fashion
US Retail Sales Growth Slows as Big-Ticket Purchases Slip - The Business of Fashion
Nike plans for three more years of decline
stories.summary: Nike aims to grow revenue by $5 billion between fiscal 2027 and 2031. The plan begins with two more years of falling sales. The company is currently working through a cost savings plan while navigating a projected downturn for its Jordan Brand.

Nike CFO Says It Will Take Two Years for Jordan Brand to Return to Growth
stories.summary: At Nike’s first investor day in nine years, the company’s newly-minted executive vice president and chief financial officer Dave Denton laid out the path to Nike’s return to growth through numbers. “I’ve been at Nike now for just about 100 days, and in that time, I’ve looked very closely at

stories.title: Gucci cuts prices to revive demand
stories.summary: Gucci has reduced prices on selected handbags, footwear and ready-to-wear items. A crystal-embellished Padlock bag in France dropped from €3,500 to €2,450. The adjustments, flagged by analyst Luca Solca, are regular selling prices rather than end-of-season markdowns. The brand is attempting to revive demand.

stories.title: L’Oréal US Settles Hair Relaxer Cancer Cases During First Trial - The Business of Fashion
Primark Opens New Pentagon City Store With Affordable Fashion, NFL Gear and Grand Opening Giveaways - DC News Now
Failed Chain David Jones Owes Creditors at Least A$459 Million - The Business of Fashion
JD Sports completes share buyback
stories.summary: JD Sports Fashion has completed the second and final £100 million tranche of its £200 million share buyback program. The company acquired over 117 million shares at an average price of £0.8495. It now holds 79.8 million shares in treasury.

stories.title: | TJX faces its toughest test as competition heats up - Fibre2Fashion
Milburn Review proposes National Insurance cuts for retail
stories.summary: The government-commissioned Milburn Review recommends reducing employer National Insurance contributions for workers aged 21 to 24. The proposal would double the earnings threshold for these contributions from £5,000 to £10,000. Retailers have previously cited high employment costs as a significant financial challenge.

stories.title: Daydream launches AI fashion agent
stories.summary: Daydream has released an AI agent capable of searching across 10,000 brands to build outfits and manage purchases. The tool requires shopper approval before any transaction completes. The company raised $50 million in seed funding to expand from basic recommendations into monitored, approved purchases.

stories.title: Daydream Launches First-Ever Autonomous Agent for Fashion Shopping, Styling and Checkout
stories.summary: Available in the Daydream iOS app or by text message, the new personal AI stylist can shop with you, build an outfit and let you try it on and buy for you in one conversation NEW YORK, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Daydream, the AI-powered shopping platform built for fashion,

stories.title: Fermat raises $8 million to expand into garment production
stories.summary: Barcelona-based Fermat has raised $8 million in seed funding to open a New York office. The platform, which serves over 350 customers, plans to move its software beyond design visualization into garment production. It is launching a tool to convert designs into factory-ready specifications.

stories.title: Fermat raises $8M to bridge the gap between fashion designers and manufacturers - Tech.eu
AI fashion technology startup Fermat raises $8 million seed as customers include Asos and New Look
stories.summary: Fermat, a Barcelona-based AI platform for the fashion industry, has raised $8 million in seed funding to open a New York office and expand its software from a design tool to full garment production. To begin, the company, which launched in 2022, is launching Techpacks, a tool which turns designs

stories.summary: Set Trending Topics as a preferred source on Google. From moodboard to factory floor in a few clicks: Fermat, the Barcelona-based A.I. fashion design platform, has raised $8 million (about 6.8 million euros) in seed funding. The start-up will use the money to open a New York office and to

stories.title: Fermat raises €7.26 million for AI fashion design
stories.summary: Barcelona-based Fermat has raised €7.26 million in Seed funding to expand its software from design tools into full garment production. The company claims it is an emerging category leader in AI-native fashion design, citing near-zero customer churn. It plans to open a New York office.

stories.title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million for supply chain automation
stories.summary: Pedestal AI has emerged from stealth with $4.7 million in seed funding to automate supply chain logistics. The startup says its agentic AI agents make deliveries faster and more reliable. It has already worked with Fortune 500 companies and major shipping firms to reduce friction in shipping.

stories.title: Brands look to AI for holiday shopping
stories.summary: Brands are experimenting with AI to help customers navigate their websites during the holiday season. The goal is to make the shopping experience feel easy and encourage users to complete their purchases. Retailers are currently testing various ways to integrate these tools into the customer journey.

stories.title: Zalando to launch AI shopping agent in 2027
stories.summary: European retailer Zalando plans to let shoppers buy products from other brands directly through its platform using AI agents. The service, Zalando Extended, will handle purchases on behalf of customers. The company is currently testing the feature with home retailer Westwing before a full rollout in 2027.

stories.title: Meet the Rising Startups Revamping the Fashion Rental Industry - Fashionista
LVMH opens applications for 2027 young designer prize
stories.summary: LVMH has opened applications for its 14th annual prize for designers aged 18 to 40. The competition offers a €400,000 top prize and a year of mentorship. Designers must have created at least two collections to be eligible for the award, which serves as an industry launchpad.

stories.title: LVMH prize applications now open
stories.summary: The 14th edition of the LVMH Prize for Young Designers is accepting applications until January 10. Semifinalists will gather in Paris in March for a showroom event where the public can view their work online. A jury will eventually decide the winner of the global competition.

stories.title: LVMH prize returns for 14th year
stories.summary: Applications are open for the 14th LVMH Prize, which offers a €400,000 cash award to emerging fashion talent. The competition has previously supported designers like Grace Wales Bonner and Martine Rose. Candidates present their work to industry legends in hopes of distinguishing themselves as the new guard.

stories.title: NITDA launches festival to connect startups with corporate challenges
stories.summary: The National Information Technology Development Agency has unveiled the Builders Festival to link startups with operational challenges from government and financial institutions. The initiative aims to help startups develop technology solutions that address institutional needs, potentially converting these innovations into commercial products and sustainable businesses.

stories.title: Exclusive | Corporate-Card Startup Ramp Raising Funds at $70 Billion Valuation - WSJ
Exclusive | Cyber Startup Corma Raises $125 Million for Defensive AI Agents - WSJ
Exclusive | Genesis AI, a Robotics Startup, Raises $500 Million - WSJ
Model ML raises €227 million for financial AI agents
stories.summary: London-based Model ML has raised €227 million in Series B funding at a €1.3 billion valuation. The company develops personalised AI agents for financial and professional services. It plans to use the capital to expand its research and engineering teams in London and New York.

stories.title: Isomorphic Labs raises €4.5 billion for AI drug discovery
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs has announced a €4.5 billion Series C round to advance its AI-driven medicine design. The company says its conviction is that biology can be modelled at the molecular level and accelerated through AI. Existing investors including Alphabet participated in the funding round.

stories.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads through Aleph partnership
stories.summary: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT advertising presence to 44 countries through an exclusive reseller partnership with Aleph. The company describes ChatGPT as a new kind of advertising environment where people come to learn and make decisions. Brands can now contract and pay for ads through local support.

stories.title: VC funding for AI startups slows
stories.summary: The latest batch of Y Combinator startups has raised $144 million since Demo Day, averaging about $630,000 per company. One startup accounted for $108 million of that total. Market observers suggest that for many recent startups, funding has become difficult to secure.

stories.title: Report tracks $923 million in African startup collapses
stories.summary: A report by the Midlo Research Institute found that 20 of the largest startup failures in Kenya, Nigeria and Ghana raised $923 million, with only $5 million documented as returned to investors. The study traces how these collapses unfold from the peak of funding rounds.
